name: Plasma
author: E. T. Carter
description: Bright classic plasma. Layered sine interference in a folded domain rolls smooth high-chroma bands across the whole frame, every band sweeping all four palette hues in order, with white-hot cores where the waves pile up in phase and fine electric filaments threading through. Genuinely bright and electric, not a dark wash.

params.label: Flow speed
params.effect: How fast the interference rolls and the bands flow; 0 freezes the plasma.

params.label: Band scale
params.effect: Frequency of the bands across the frame; low is a few huge sweeps, high packs in many narrow ripples.

params.label: Warp
params.effect: Depth of the domain fold; 0 leaves clean regular interference, high bends it into liquid folds.

params.label: Colour cycles
params.effect: How many times the palette wheel repeats per interference swing; low is broad two-tone sweeps, high is tight rainbow banding.

params.label: Core heat
params.effect: Brightness of the white-hot cores where the waves stack; 0 keeps pure palette colour throughout.

params.label: Filaments
params.effect: Strength of the fine electric threads running through the bands; 0 is smooth plasma only.

params.label: Mouse influence
params.effect: How strongly the pointer bends the field toward it; 0 ignores the mouse.
